{{nihongo|'''Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha'''|豊岡上天神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tosa Province]].

'''Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha''' (とよおかかみてんじんじゃ{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Shikinaisha)|1987}} / とよおかかみてんじんしゃ{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Heibonsha)|1983}}) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Jōtsūji-jima, Okō-chō, {{ill|Nankoku, Kōchi|Q861621|qid=Q861621}}, {{ill|Kōchi Prefecture|Q134093|qid=Q134093}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and its former rank under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}.

It stands at the southwestern foot of Mt. Okō, where {{ill|Okō Castle|Q11048926|qid=Q11048926}} is located.

=== Enshrined deity ===
The shrine enshrines the following one deity{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Shikinaisha)|1987}}.
* {{ill|Toyouke-hime|abstract|Q2983724|bcl|Toyoukebime|es|Toyouke Ōmikami|fr|Toyouke Ōmikami|ja|トヨウケビメ|kk|Тоёукэ бимэ|ru|Тоёукэ бимэ|simple|Toyōke Ōmikami|sv|Toyouke Ōmikami|tok|jan sewi suli Tojoke|zh|豐宇氣毘賣神|qid=Q2983724|lt=Yafune Toyouke-hime-no-Mikoto}}

In ''Tosa-koku Shikishakō'', a relation is pointed out between the shrine name “Toyooka” and the deity name “Toyouke-hime (Toyouka-no-me)”{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Shikinaisha)|1987}}{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Heibonsha)|1983}}.

=== History ===
[[File:Oko castle zenkei.JPG|thumb|200px|right|Mt. Okō with {{ill|Okō Castle|Q11048926|qid=Q11048926}}]]
Its history is unclear{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Shikinaisha)|1987}}. It is said to have begun when the agricultural deity {{ill|Toyouke-hime|abstract|Q2983724|bcl|Toyoukebime|es|Toyouke Ōmikami|fr|Toyouke Ōmikami|ja|トヨウケビメ|kk|Тоёукэ бимэ|ru|Тоёукэ бимэ|simple|Toyōke Ōmikami|sv|Toyouke Ōmikami|tok|jan sewi suli Tojoke|zh|豐宇氣毘賣神|qid=Q2983724|lt=Toyouke-hime-no-Mikoto}} (Toyouke-hime-no-Mikoto) was worshiped during development of the area{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Shikinaisha)|1987}}. It was originally on top of Mt. Okō, but is also said to have been moved when {{ill|Okō Castle|Q11048926|qid=Q11048926}} was built{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Shikinaisha)|1987}}.

In the ''{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}'' compiled in {{ill|927|ab|927|af|927|am|927 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|927|ar|927|ary|927|ast|927|avk|927|az|927|azb|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|bar|927|bcl|927|be|927|be_x_old|927|bg|927|bn|৯২৭|bpy|মারি ৯২৭|br|927|bs|927.|ca|927|cdo|927 nièng|ceb|927|ckb|٩٢٧|crh|927|cs|927|csb|927|cv|927|cy|927|da|927|de|927|el|927|eml|927|eo|927|es|927|et|927|eu|927|fa|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|fi|927|fo|927|fr|927|fy|927|ga|927|gan|927年|gd|927|gl|927|he|927|hi|927|hr|927.|ht|927 (almanak jilyen)|hu|927|hy|927|id|927|ilo|927|io|927|is|927|it|927|ja|927年|jv|927|ka|927|kaa|927|kk|927 жыл|ko|927년|la|927|lb|927|lij|927|lmo|927|lt|927 m.|lv|927. gads|map_bms|927|mdf|927|mg|927|mhr|927|mi|927|mk|927|mr|इ.स. ९२७|mrj|927 и|ms|927|mzn|۹۲۷|nah|927|nap|927|nds|927|new|सन् ९२७|nl|927|nn|927|no|927|nrm|927|nso|927|oc|927|or|୯୨୭|os|927-æм аз|pl|927|pnb|927|pt|927|qu|927|ro|927|ru|927 год|rue|927|sa|९२७|scn|927|sd|927ع|se|927|sh|927.|shn|927|si|927|sk|927|smn|927|sq|927|sr|927|su|927|sv|927|sw|927|tg|Соли 927|th|พ.ศ. 1470|tk|927|tl|927|tly|927|tr|927|tt|927 ел|uk|927|ur|927ء|uz|927|vec|927|vi|927|war|927|wuu|927年|xmf|927|zh|927年|zh_min_nan|927 nî|zh_yue|927年|qid=Q30470}} ({{ill|Enchō|Q1327274|qid=Q1327274}} 5), the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Jinmyōchō}}'' lists “Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha” in {{ill|Nagaoka District, Kōchi|Q1132123|qid=Q1132123}}, {{ill|Tosa Province|Q857330|qid=Q857330}}, and this is identified with this shrine{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Shikinaisha)|1987}}. As for “Toyooka,” theories include an old name for the place name “Okō” (''{{ill|Tosa Monogatari|ja|土佐物語|zh|土佐物語|qid=Q11423040}}''), “a rich hill in Nagaoka District,” or derivation from “okokufu” because of proximity to the Tosa provincial office, but it is uncertain{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Shikinaisha)|1987}}. The origin of “Tenjin” is also unclear, with multiple theories{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Shikinaisha)|1987}}.

It is inferred to have later been revered by the {{ill|Chōsokabe clan|cs|Klan Čósokabe|de|Chōsokabe (Klan)|es|Clan Chōsokabe|fa|خاندان چوسوکابه|fr|Clan Chōsokabe|it|Clan Chōsokabe|ja|長宗我部氏|ko|조소카베씨|pt|Clã Chōsokabe|ru|Тёсокабэ (род)|sr|Клан Чосокабе|tr|Chōsokabe boyu|zh|長宗我部氏|qid=Q981303}}, based at Okō Castle, but there are no documents and details are unclear{{Sfn|Toyooka Kami Tenjinsha (Shikinaisha)|1987}}.
